instruction: Change VLC's recording path so that saved recordings go to the Desktop folder instead of the default location.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing VLC's recording folder path to /home/user/Desktop by setting input-record-path=/home/user/Desktop in the VLC config file. The evaluator uses the existing is_vlc_recordings_folder metric function to verify the recording path is set correctly. The get_vlc_config getter reads the VLC config file (~/.config/vlc/vlcrc) and the metric checks if input-record-path matches /home/user/Desktop. No new functions needed - reusing existing VLC evaluation infrastructure.
metadata.similarity_to_original: Very similar - both tasks involve changing a single VLC preference setting through the UI. Original disables splash cone icon, this changes the recording folder path.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: getter reads VLC config file and metric checks if input-record-path is set to /home/user/Desktop
Expected parameter handling is correct: metric directly accesses rule['recording_file_path'] which matches the framework's get_rule() return value
Postconfig appropriately restarts VLC to ensure config changes are loaded before verification
Expected value is semantically correct: /home/user/Desktop is the appropriate path for Linux Desktop folder
Complete coverage: instruction asks to change recording path, evaluator verifies exactly that setting
Robust edge case handling: metric handles missing config file, missing config key, and exceptions gracefully
